summary: ```markdown # Explanation of New Features in Patch Version 7.3: Introduction of AI New Features! ## Introduction In this video, we will discuss the new features and functional optimizations of the 7.3 patch version, explained mainly in four aspects: the main functions, 2D functionalities, materials, and rendering. ## Main Functions ### AI Sticker Generator The first main function introduced is the **AI sticker generator**. When creating a sticker, there is no need for manual editing. For example, by entering keywords, you can automatically delete the background. You can also preview the created sticker pattern on 3D clothing to ensure that the sticker matches the clothing design. Currently, the AI sticker generator can effortlessly create stickers with embroidery, design, and wave art characteristics. Note that this is a public version of the function, and future usage policies may change. #### How to Open the AI Sticker Generator There are two ways to access the AI sticker generator, depending on your application scenario: 1. **Creating a New Sticker Pattern**: Click on the sticker in the object window, then click on the magic bar icon above, which represents the AI sticker generator. 2. **Using an Existing Sticker**: Select the desired sticker, then click on the attribute editor next to the default parameters to access the AI sticker generator. #### Interface of the AI Sticker Generator The interface consists of several options: - **Pattern Type**: You can create a sticker pattern closer to your vision. After selecting the art style from the drop-down menu, choose from three styles: embroidery, fashion, and wave art. If you wish to generate a sticker unaffected by any specific pattern type, select option five. For a transparent background, ensure to check that option. - **Keyword Prompt**: In the keyword prompt box, enter keywords describing the desired pattern. The AI sticker will be previewed at the bottom after creation. Clicking on the history record option will display the creation history. However, note that the history will only be retained until the cloud software is closed. #### Function Use Process To create an AI sticker, enter the keyword that describes the image you wish to create. Here are some tips for entering keywords: - The AI sticker generator supports languages from over 50 countries. Although any language can be used, it is recommended to enter the keyword in English for better accuracy. - Enter a single word instead of long descriptive sentences, as lengthy descriptions may distort the image. - Use a dot or space to separate keywords.
